slides.sub: Rave went mainstream. Four years that moved the world.
The Dust Brothers — later Chemical Brothers — started mixing rave and hip-hop there.
Two former ravers reinvented the rave inside a studio.

text: Every Friday at the Concorde Club.
A party name became a genre name.
slides.sub: You've Come a Long Way, Baby — 12 million copies worldwide.

slides.note: The Prodigy, July 1997. Essex hardcore ravers at the top of the Billboard. Nobody saw it coming.

slides.sub: Going mainstream was not death. It was a door to what came next.
